parole.significato: to answer, to reply; to respond
parole.testo: From Proto-Finnic *vastat'ak, equivalent to vasta- (“against”) + -ta. * (to correspond to): Probably a semantic loan, ultimately from Medieval Latin correspondeō (“to correspond”) (from respondeō (“to respond”)). * (to be responsible for, in charge for, accountable to): Semantic loan from Swedish an
